items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Staying in trade buzz
items.text:
The Colts have an offer of "at least a second-round pick and more" on the table for Taylor but are "holding out for more," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Full workload expected Sunday
items.text:
McCaffrey is expected to take on a full workload Sunday against the Raiders, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mike Evans: 'Questionable at best' for Week 10
items.text:
Evans (Achilles), who won't play in Sunday's game against the Raiders, appears to be "questionable at best" for next Sunday's road matchup with the Cowboys, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Likely inactive Sunday
items.text:
Watson (concussion) is expected to be inactive for Sunday's game at New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Not expected to return Sunday
items.text:
Monangai (thumb/toe) isn't slated to play in Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, but he's expected to return after the Bears' Week 10 bye in a Week 11 matchup with the Saints, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
